title: Rendley AI Video Editor
description: Pick an operation, paste your Rendley API key, and fill in the fields that operation needs. Each run performs one operation and pushes one result item.

rendley_api_key.title: Rendley API key
rendley_api_key.description: Create one at https://app.rendley.com/settings. AI actions consume credits; the agent and renders need an active subscription.

operation.title: Operation
enumTitles: Prompt to video (AI agent edit, then render)
AI action (any Rendley AI action with raw parameters)
Export (render an existing project to MP4)

project_id.title: Project ID
project_id.description: The Rendley project to work in. Required for every operation except prompt_to_video, where it is optional (the agent creates a project when omitted).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: prompt_to_video: what the agent should create or change, for example "Cut this interview down to a 30-second teaser with captions".
prompt.prefill: Create a 15-second product teaser from these clips with upbeat captions.

file_urls.title: Media URLs
file_urls.description: prompt_to_video: public URLs of clips, images or audio for the agent to work with.

thread_id.title: Thread ID
thread_id.description: prompt_to_video: continue a previous agent conversation on the same project.

render.title: Render MP4 after the agent edit
render.description: prompt_to_video: export the project once the agent finishes. Turn off to keep only the edited project.

action.title: AI action
action.description: ai_action and estimate_cost: the action name, for example text-to-speech, generate-image, generate-video, generate-music, generate-sound-effect, upscale-image, remove-image-background, remove-video-background, voice-isolation, voice-changer, lipsync, video-translate, transcribe. Use "export" with estimate_cost to price a render.

params.title: Action parameters
params.description: ai_action and estimate_cost: the model parameters as JSON. File inputs go in "media" (a public URL, media ID or file hash); lipsync uses "video_media" and "audio_media". Schemas are at https://api.rendley.com/v1/ai/models/{model_id}.

model_id.title: Model ID
model_id.description: Optional model for AI actions, for example kling-v2.6. Leave empty for Rendley's default. The catalog is at https://api.rendley.com/v1/ai/tools.

media.title: Source media
media.description: transcribe and dub_video: a public URL of the audio or video, or the media ID or file hash of an upload in the project.

start_time.title: Start time (seconds)
start_time.description: transcribe: only transcribe from this point.

end_time.title: End time (seconds)
end_time.description: transcribe: only transcribe up to this point.

output_language.title: Target language
output_language.description: dub_video: language code to dub into, for example es or de. The list is at https://api.rendley.com/v1/ai/video-translate/languages.

save_to_kvs.title: Copy output files to the key-value store
save_to_kvs.description: Rendley's download URLs expire after a few hours. When on, the output file is also stored in the run's key-value store as OUTPUT_VIDEO, OUTPUT_MEDIA or OUTPUT_TRANSCRIPT.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Advanced: leave empty unless Rendley gave you a different API host.
api_base_url.sectionDescription: Only needed for non-production Rendley hosts.
